[animalDiversity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/animalDiversity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identifying major animal groups requires diagnostic characteristics, including skeletal structure, body coverings, limbs, and developmental patterns, rather than incidental external resemblance.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize major animal groups by reliable body features rather than superficial similarities.

##### Distinguish Vertebrates and Invertebrates

[distinguishVertebratesAndInvertebrates.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/distinguishVertebratesAndInvertebrates.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the presence of a vertebral column as the anatomical dividing line between these two broad groups.

**User-friendly description (en):** Distinguish animals with a backbone from those without one.

##### Recognize Amphibian Characteristics

[recognizeAmphibianCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeAmphibianCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify characteristic features of a group in which development is often associated with water and adults may use lungs and skin for respiration.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize common features of amphibians and their development.

##### Recognize Annelid Characteristics

[recognizeAnnelidCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeAnnelidCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the segmented body of annelids and distinguish them from nematodes and flatworms, even where all these animals have similarly elongated bodies.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize segmented worms and distinguish them from other worm-shaped animals.

##### Recognize Arachnid Characteristics

[recognizeArachnidCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeArachnidCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize arthropods with characteristic chelicerae and usually four pairs of walking legs in adults; distinguish spiders, ticks and mites, and scorpions from insects.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize spiders and other arachnids by their distinctive body features.

##### Recognize Bird Characteristics

[recognizeBirdCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeBirdCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use feathers as the primary diagnostic characteristic of birds, regardless of their ability to fly.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize birds by their feathers, even when they cannot fly.

##### Recognize Cnidarian Characteristics

[recognizeCnidarianCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeCnidarianCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize cnidarians by stinging cells and the characteristic body plans of polyps and medusae; do not regard the medusa form as obligatory for every member.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize animals such as jellyfish and corals by their stinging cells.

##### Recognize Common Local Animals

[recognizeCommonLocalAnimals.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeCommonLocalAnimals.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify familiar local species from a characteristic combination of body structure, coverings, and modes of movement.

**User-friendly description (en):** Identify familiar animals using characteristic body structures and coverings.

##### Recognize Crustacean Characteristics

[recognizeCrustaceanCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeCrustaceanCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize diverse crustaceans by jointed appendages, antennae, and characteristic structural traits; do not treat ten legs as a universal characteristic of crustaceans.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize the varied structures of crustaceans without assuming all have ten legs.

##### Recognize Echinoderm Characteristics

[recognizeEchinodermCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeEchinodermCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify marine invertebrates with a water vascular system and characteristic adult symmetry, distinguishing sea stars, sea urchins, and other representatives.

**User-friendly description (en):** Identify sea stars and other echinoderms by their distinctive structures.

##### Recognize Fish Characteristics

[recognizeFishCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeFishCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify typical traits of aquatic vertebrates with gill respiration and fins while accounting for the diversity of fish.

**User-friendly description (en):** Identify typical features of fish while recognizing their diversity.

##### Recognize Flatworm Characteristics

[recognizeFlatwormCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeFlatwormCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the flattened body and other features of flatworms, including free-living and parasitic forms, without confusing them with annelids.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize flatworms and distinguish them from segmented worms.

##### Recognize Insect Characteristics

[recognizeInsectCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeInsectCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify six legs, three main body regions, and other characteristic features of adult insects.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize insects by their six legs and three main body regions.

##### Recognize Mammal Characteristics

[recognizeMammalCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeMammalCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify members by mammary glands and characteristic body coverings without assuming that every mammal gives birth to live young.

**User-friendly description (en):** Identify mammals by their defining features without assuming all give live birth.

##### Recognize Mollusc Characteristics

[recognizeMolluscCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeMolluscCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the soft body, mantle, and other characteristic features of gastropods, bivalves, and cephalopods, taking into account that not all molluscs have an external shell.

**User-friendly description (en):** Identify molluscs by their characteristic soft bodies and other structures.

##### Recognize Nematode Characteristics

[recognizeNematodeCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeNematodeCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the unsegmented elongated bodies of roundworms and features of their lifestyles, including free-living and parasitic forms.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize roundworms by their unsegmented bodies and other traits.

##### Recognize Reptile Characteristics

[recognizeReptileCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeReptileCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify members by characteristics of scaled skin and reproductive features of terrestrial amniotes.

**User-friendly description (en):** Identify reptile characteristics, including skin and reproduction.

##### Recognize Sponge Characteristics

[recognizeSpongeCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeSpongeCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the porous body structure and filter-feeding of sponges, explaining that they lack true tissues and organs.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize sponges by their porous bodies and filter-feeding.

#### Behavior

Skills: 3

[behavior.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/behavior/behavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Animal actions arise in response to signals and needs; observation makes it possible to identify defense, communication, and benefits of living in groups.

**User-friendly description (en):** Explore how animal behavior supports communication, protection and group life.

##### Explain Benefits of Group Behavior

[explainBenefitsOfGroupBehavior.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/behavior/skills/explainBenefitsOfGroupBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how cooperative foraging, defense, or care for offspring may improve the success of individuals.

**User-friendly description (en):** Discover how group behavior may help animals feed, defend themselves and care for young.

##### Explain the Role of Signals in Animal Communication

[explainTheRoleOfSignalsInAnimalCommunication.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/behavior/skills/explainTheRoleOfSignalsInAnimalCommunication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sound, smell, movement, or coloration to information received by another individual.

**User-friendly description (en):** Explain how animals communicate using sounds, movement and other signals.

##### Recognize Defensive Behavior

[recognizeDefensiveBehavior.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/behavior/skills/recognizeDefensiveBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether fleeing, freezing, distraction, or attacking reduces a threat in a given situation.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize behaviors animals use when threatened.

#### Nutrition and Development

Skills: 4

[nutritionAndDevelopment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/nutritionAndDevelopment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Food sources differ among animal groups, while their life cycles may involve body transformations or development without a drastic change in form.

**User-friendly description (en):** Discover how diets and life cycles differ among animals.

##### Classify Animals by Diet

[classifyAnimalsByDiet.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/skills/classifyAnimalsByDiet.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify examples as herbivores, carnivores, or omnivores according to actual diets rather than animal names.

**User-friendly description (en):** Classify animals by what they actually eat.

##### Compare Development With and Without Metamorphosis

[compareDevelopmentWithAndWithoutMetamorphosis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/skills/compareDevelopmentWithAndWithoutMetamorphosis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare life cycles involving radical structural change with cycles in which young individuals resemble adults.

**User-friendly description (en):** Compare animals that change form during development with those that do not.

##### Distinguish Juveniles and Adults

[distinguishJuvenilesAndAdults.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/skills/distinguishJuvenilesAndAdults.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine an individual’s developmental stage by body proportions, coverings, or reproductive maturity.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize differences between juvenile and adult animals.

##### Explain Complete Metamorphosis in Insects

[explainCompleteMetamorphosisInInsects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/skills/explainCompleteMetamorphosisInInsects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the four developmental stages of insects with complete metamorphosis: egg, larva, pupa, and imago; using butterflies, beetles, or flies as examples, distinguish the markedly different functions and structures of larvae and adults.

**User-friendly description (en):** Follow the egg, larva, pupa and adult stages of complete insect metamorphosis.

#### Structure and Functions

Skills: 4

[structureAndFunctions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/structureAndFunctions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The forms of limbs, body coverings, and sensory structures are explained by their roles in locomotion, orientation, and protection against danger.

**User-friendly description (en):** Explore how animal structures help them move, sense and protect themselves.

##### Explain the Role of Sensory Organs in Behavior

[explainTheRoleOfSensoryOrgansInBehavior.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/skills/explainTheRoleOfSensoryOrgansInBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect perception of sounds, smells, light, or vibrations with orientation and finding food.

**User-friendly description (en):** See how sensory organs help animals find food and orient themselves.

##### Identify Protective Adaptations in Animals

[identifyProtectiveAdaptationsInAnimals.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/skills/identifyProtectiveAdaptationsInAnimals.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the function of camouflage, shells or armor, spines, and other defensive structures in particular situations.

**User-friendly description (en):** Recognize structures that help animals defend themselves.

##### Relate Body Coverings to Their Functions

[relateBodyCoveringsToTheirFunctions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/skills/relateBodyCoveringsToTheirFunctions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how feathers, fur, scales, and skin provide protection, thermal insulation, or water balance.

**User-friendly description (en):** Explain how fur, feathers, scales and skin protect animal bodies.

##### Relate Limb Structure to Locomotion

[relateLimbStructureToLocomotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/skills/relateLimbStructureToLocomotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the shape of legs, fins, or wings to the requirements of walking, swimming, digging, or flying.

**User-friendly description (en):** Connect the shapes of limbs with walking, swimming, digging or flying.
